issues.title: With two wallets installed, the dApp talks to Rabby instead of MetaMask
issues.summary: Both wallets announced themselves through EIP-6963 and the user picked MetaMask, but requests went to Rabby (probably via window.ethereum). Users with two wallets end up signing with the wrong one.
stepsToReproduce: Have two wallets installed (MetaMask and Rabby), pick MetaMask in the dApp.
issues.expected: Use the provider from the EIP-6963 announcement the user selected.

issues.title: Clicking 'Submit Transaction' twice while the app is busy sends two requests
issues.summary: With a slow RPC the button stayed clickable, and a second click produced another eth_sendTransaction (supply(0xA0b8…eB48 (USD Coin), 100000000) to 0xc3d688B66703497DAA19211EEdff47f25384cdc3). A user who approves both pays twice.
stepsToReproduce: Click the main button a second time while the app is busy, as an impatient user would.
issues.expected: Disable the button as soon as it is clicked, until the request is answered.

issues.title: Flow breaks when the RPC is slow
issues.summary: With 2.5s of latency on every RPC call the flow did not complete: Step 8 (Approve eth_sendTransaction to 0xc3d6…cdc3): The wallet request doesn't match the flow: expected a call to 0xf2b9fdb8, the dApp calls supply.
stepsToReproduce: Click the main button a second time while the app is busy, as an impatient user would.
issues.expected: Keep working, just slower, with a loading state.
issues.actual: Step 8 (Approve eth_sendTransaction to 0xc3d6…cdc3): The wallet request doesn't match the flow: expected a call to 0xf2b9fdb8, the dApp calls supply

issues.title: The button asks for an approval and the request is an approval of Unlimited: Approve USDC for TransparentUpgradeableProxy
issues.summary: The button says “Approve & Add”. The wallet is asked to approve unlimited USDC for 0xc3d6…cdc3 (TransparentUpgradeableProxy, verified).
issues.expected: A request that does what “Approve & Add” says
issues.actual: Worth a look. The button asks for an approval and the request is an approval of Unlimited. The model disagrees: The page sets up a supply of exactly 100 USDC. The header button says "Supply 100.0000 USDC", the pending action is "Supply USDC 100.0000", and the wallet balance preview drops by about 100 USDC. The wallet request is a USDC approve() for an unlimited amount (2^256 − 1). The spender, 0xc3d6…cdc3, looks like Compound's cUSDCv3 Comet proxy, so the counterparty is probably the expected one. The token (USDC) and the action (an approval before a supply) also fit "Approve & Add". The amount does not. A user who read the page would expect an approval for 100 USDC, not permanent permission to move their entire USDC balance and anything they receive later. An unlimited approval behind a flow that names a specific amount fails the amount check. Unlimited approval. Deployment date unknown.

issues.title: Doesn't match the flow's expectation: Supply 100000000 on TransparentUpgradeableProxy
issues.summary: The button says “Submit Transaction”. The wallet is asked to call supply(0xA0b8…eB48 (USD Coin), 100000000) on 0xc3d6…cdc3 (TransparentUpgradeableProxy, verified); on the fork −100 USDC leaves the wallet.
issues.expected: A request that does what “Submit Transaction” says
issues.actual: Worth a look. Doesn't match the flow's expectation. Deployment date unknown.

issues.title: The page doesn't explain what happened after reject
issues.summary: After the rejection the UI goes back to its pre-submit state: the 'Withdraw USDC 40.0000' pending action is still listed and 'Submit Transaction' is still active, so retrying works, but no toast, banner or inline message says the request was rejected. Catch the wallet's user-rejected error (code 4001 / ACTION_REJECTED) and show a message like 'Transaction rejected in wallet — submit again to retry' next to the pending action.
stepsToReproduce: Reject the flow's main request in the wallet (error 4001).
issues.expected: Show that the request was rejected and let the user try again.

issues.title: The page doesn't explain what happened after low gas
issues.summary: After the low-gas failure the page looks unchanged: the 'Withdraw USDC 40.0000' pending action and the 'Submit Transaction' button are still there, with no error, toast or banner saying there isn't enough ETH for gas, and the 0.0000 ETH balance isn't flagged. Catch the insufficient-funds error from the wallet/RPC and show a clear message like 'Not enough ETH to pay gas, add ETH and retry' next to Submit Transaction.
stepsToReproduce: Leave the wallet with almost no ETH for gas.
issues.expected: Tell the user there isn't enough ETH for gas and let them try again.

The header button says "Supply 100.0000 USDC", the pending action is "Supply USDC 100.0000", and the wallet balance preview drops by about 100 USDC. The wallet request is a USDC approve() for an unlimited amount (2^256 − 1). The spender, 0xc3d6…cdc3, looks like Compound's cUSDCv3 Comet proxy, so the counterparty is probably the expected one. The token (USDC) and the action (an approval before a supply) also fit "Approve & Add". The amount does not. A user who read the page would expect an approval for 100 USDC, not permanent permission to move their entire USDC balance and anything they receive later. An unlimited approval behind a flow that names a specific amount fails the amount check. Unlimited approval. Deployment date unknown.
signingReviews.advice: Limit the approval to the amount shown, or use a permit with a deadline. Make the button say what the wallet will ask for: the action, the token and the amount.
